about_the_game:
Pave your path to sainthood with the Becoming Saint Supporter Pack and get access to a curated collection of exclusive content to enrich and highlight your journey through medieval Italy.

Out Game elements

  • Original Soundtrack: Listen to the moody atmosphere of Becoming Saint with the full OST containing 11 tracks.

  • Social Media Profile Picture: Display your devotion with magnificent profile images designed from the side characters of the game.

  • Posters & Wallpapers: Bring the world of Becoming Saint to your screens or walls with high-resolution artwork and printable poster designs.

  • Emoji Pack: Express yourself on your favorite social platforms with that set of custom emojis inspired by the game’s characters and moods.

  • Concept Art & Sketches: Peek behind the curtain with early concepts, rough sketches, and visual development from early researches and design by the team.

In Game elements

  • Exclusive Pet Skins: Give your faithful companion a fresh look with three exclusive skins only available in the Supporter Pack.

    Note: The game soundtrack, Social Media Profile Picture, Posters & Wallpapers, Emoji Pack & Concept Art & Sketches will be directly downloaded at the root of your Becoming Saint game folder. Access your local folder of the game to get the files once you've purchased this supporter pack.
